book_name: 沪教版牛津英语九年级下册

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.ex: The repetition of the same words made the lesson boring.
words.ex_cn: 相同词语的重复让这堂课变得无聊。
words.en: The act of repeating something that has already been said or written.

words.tr:
adj. 美国的；美洲的；
n. 美国人；美洲人；
words.ex: She bought an American car.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一辆美国车。
words.en: relating to the United States of America or its people, culture, or language

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: We took a different route to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们换了条路线以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A route is a way from one place to another, or the path that something follows to reach a destination.

words.ex: The discovery of penicillin saved millions of lives.
words.ex_cn: 青霉素的发现拯救了数百万人的生命。
words.en: The act of finding something that had not been known before.

words.tr:
n. 上升；提高；
v. 上升；提高；
words.ex: There was a rise in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度上升了。
words.en: If an amount or level rises, it increases; if something rises, it moves upwards; if you rise, you stand up; if you rise, you get out of bed.

words.tr:
n. 官员；高级职员；
adj. 官方的；正式的；
words.ex: The official announced new rules for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 这位官员宣布了节日的新规定。
words.en: An official is a person who holds a position of authority in a government or organization, or something that is authorized or formally recognized.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: There is a clear relation between exercise and health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间有明显的关联。
words.en: A relation between two things is a connection or link between them.

words.tr:
n. 贸易；交易；行业；
v. 贸易；交易；
words.ex: The two countries increased their trade last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这两个国家增加了贸易。
words.en: Trade involves the buying and selling of goods and services. It can refer to the exchange of goods and services between parties, or to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: He loves eating foreign food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃什么外国食物。
words.en: belonging to or connected with a country that is not your own

words.ex: The navy launched a large fleet to protect the coast.
words.ex_cn: 海军派出了一支大型舰队来保护海岸。
words.en: A fleet is a group of ships or vehicles that are controlled by one company or organization and are used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He wants to visit Africa next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年去非洲旅行。
words.en: Africa is the continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean.

words.ex: I looked everywhere, but my keys are nowhere.
words.ex_cn: 我到处找了，但我的钥匙无处可寻。
words.en: In no place or state; not anywhere.

words.ex: She wears a silk dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件丝绸连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A fine, strong, soft, lustrous fiber produced by silkworms in making cocoons and collected to make thread and fabric.

words.ex: The giraffe eats leaves from tall trees.
words.ex_cn: 长颈鹿吃高树上的叶子。
words.en: A giraffe is a large African animal with a very long neck and legs and pale brown fur with dark spots. Giraffes are the tallest living land animals.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.ex: He was a pioneer in space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 他是太空探索的先驱者。
words.en: A pioneer is someone who is one of the first people to do something that others will later develop or continue. Pioneers are also people who are among the first to go to live in a new area, especially in the past when people were trying to settle in new lands.

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 教室里有38个人。
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.ex: He built his wealth by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业积累了财富。
words.en: Wealth refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money.

words.tr:
v. 传播；扩散；散布；
n. 传播；蔓延；范围；
words.ex: The virus spread quickly through the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒在城市中迅速传播。
words.en: To spread something means to open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

words.tr: phrase. 畅所欲言；打开；开放
words.ex: Please open up and tell me how you really feel.
words.ex_cn: 请畅所欲言，告诉我你真正的感受。
words.en: To make something available or accessible; to start or begin something.

words.ex: They go on a trip every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天去旅行。
words.en: To go on a trip means to travel somewhere, especially for pleasure or a holiday.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: phrase. 启航；开船；出发（尤指乘船）
words.ex: They set sail at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 他们在黎明时启航。
words.en: To begin a journey on water by ship.

words.ex: He is known as a good teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为一位好老师。
words.en: If someone or something is known as a particular name, they are called by that name.

words.ex: He is known as a great teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为一位优秀的老师。
words.en: If someone or something is known as a particular name, they are called by that name.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.ex: He felt culture shock when he moved to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 当他搬到日本时，他感受到了文化冲击。
words.en: Culture shock is the feeling of disorientation experienced by someone when they are suddenly subjected to an unfamiliar culture, way of life, or set of attitudes.

words.tr:
n. 营地；
v. 宿营；露营；
words.ex: The children set up a camp near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边搭了一个营地。
words.en: A camp is a place where people live temporarily in tents or other temporary structures.

words.ex: Children laughed as the firework lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看着焰火点亮夜空，哈哈大笑。
words.en: A firework is a small device that is lit to produce a display of light, noise, and smoke, often used in celebrations.

words.ex: We ate turkey for Thanksgiving dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节晚餐上吃了火鸡。
words.en: A turkey is a large bird that is often eaten at Christmas or Thanksgiving.

words.ex: He works for an international company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家国际公司工作。
words.en: International means involving or relating to more than one country.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.tr: v. 无法做到；失败；不及格；倒闭；
words.ex: He failed to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他没能完成比赛。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.ex: He used an idiom to explain his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个成语来解释他的想法。
words.en: An idiom is a group of words in a fixed order that have a particular meaning that is different from the meanings of each word on its own.

words.ex: She wears everyday clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 她穿日常的衣服去上班。
words.en: Something that is everyday is ordinary and common, not special or unusual.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.tr: pron. 无论什么；任何事物；
words.ex: You can eat whatever you want.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你想吃的东西。
words.en: You use whatever to refer to anything or everything of a particular type; used especially when you are indicating that you do not know or care which specific thing is being referred to.

words.tr:
adj. 粉红色的；
n. 粉红色；
words.ex: The flower is pink.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是粉红色的。
words.en: Pink is a pale red color that is named after the flower of the same name. It is often associated with femininity and romance.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是紫色的。
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.ex: I like all fruits, especially apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢所有的水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use especially to emphasize that what you are saying applies more to one thing or situation than to others.

words.ex: He plays baseball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打棒球。
words.en: a game played especially in North America by two teams of nine players, in which a player hits a ball with a bat and tries to run around four bases on a large field before the other team returns the ball

words.ex: He values education very much.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视教育。
words.en: Education is the process of teaching and learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this.

words.tr:
n. 状态；州；国家；
v. 陈述；说明；
adj. 国事礼仪（或规格）的；州的；
words.ex: The state of the car is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的状态非常差。
words.en: A state is a condition or way of being that something or someone is in. It can also refer to a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under one government.

words.ex: The national flag flies high every morning.
words.ex_cn: 每天早上国旗都高高飘扬。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of a nation; common to a whole nation

words.ex: The president signed the new contract.
words.ex_cn: 总裁签署了新合同。
words.en: The president is the elected head of a republic or the head of a company or organization.

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人的闲暇时间；在某人空闲的时候
words.ex: He reads books in his spare time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: During one's free time; when one is not working or occupied with other duties.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；在一定范围内
words.ex: He understands the idea to a certain degree.
words.ex_cn: 他在一定程度上理解这个想法。
words.en: To some extent; not completely but somewhat.

words.ex: He is getting used to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他正在习惯早起。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone, so that it/they no longer seem(s) new, strange, or difficult.

words.ex: He stayed home because he was under the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他待在家里，因为他感觉不舒服。
words.en: If you say that you are under the weather, you mean that you feel slightly ill.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜明天会下雨。
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，树叶是绿色的。
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.ex: The lifeless fish floated on the water.
words.ex_cn: 那条死鱼漂在水面上。
words.en: If something is lifeless, it is either not alive or it appears to be not alive.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The sea level is rising because of global warming.
words.ex_cn: 由于全球变暖，海平面正在上升。
words.en: The average height of the sea's surface, used as a basis for measuring heights and depths on land.

words.ex: The storm destroyed the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了那座旧桥。
words.en: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

words.ex: His nature is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的本性是善良且有耐心的。
words.en: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people, including plants, animals, mountains, oceans, stars, etc. It can also refer to the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.

words.tr:
n. 表面；
v. 显露；
words.ex: The surface of the table is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的表面很光滑。
words.en: The outer or top part of something; to rise to the surface of water or to become known after being hidden or secret.

words.ex: The farmer planted corn in rich soil.
words.ex_cn: 农民在肥沃的土壤里种了玉米。
words.en: Soil is the substance on the surface of the earth in which plants grow, consisting of rock and mineral particles mixed with decayed organic matter.

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: He has a habit of waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他有早起的习惯。
words.en: A habit is something that you do often or regularly.

words.tr: adj. 正确的；合适的；正当的；
words.ex: This is the proper way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决这个问题的正确方法。
words.en: If something is proper, it is suitable or correct for a particular purpose, situation, or person.

words.ex: He is a friendly boy who smiles at everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个友好的男孩，对每个人都微笑。
words.en: If someone is friendly, they behave in a pleasant, kind way, and like to be with other people.

words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: The government provides free education.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供免费教育。
words.en: The group of people who officially control a country or the system used for controlling a country.

words.ex: My teacher is my role model.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师是我的榜样。
words.en: A role model is a person whose behavior, example, or success is or can be emulated by others, especially by younger people.

words.ex: The greenhouse effect makes the Earth warmer.
words.ex_cn: 温室效应使地球变暖。
words.en: The greenhouse effect is the process by which radiation from a planet's atmosphere warms the planet's surface to a temperature above what it would be without its atmosphere.

words.ex: The cat is in danger from the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫正处在大狗的危险中。
words.en: At risk of harm, injury, or loss.

words.tr: phrase. 由于…的结果；起因；经；因
words.ex: He was late as a result of the bus breaking down.
words.ex_cn: 由于公交车坏了，他迟到了。
words.en: Because of something that has happened.

words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: The hikers walked through the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者穿过了群山。
words.en: Large natural elevations of the earth's surface, often forming a range.

words.tr: phrase. 采取行动；提出诉讼
words.ex: He must take action now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在必须采取行动。
words.en: To do something in order to deal with a situation or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.ex: Please act as a guide for the visitors.
words.ex_cn: 请为来访者充当向导。
words.en: To function or serve in a particular role or capacity.

words.ex: The asteroid flew past Earth safely.
words.ex_cn: 这颗小行星安全地从地球旁飞过。
words.en: An asteroid is a small rocky body orbiting the sun. Large numbers of these, ranging enormously in size, are found between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter, though some have more eccentric orbits.

words.ex: The typhoon destroyed many houses last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周的台风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A typhoon is a very violent tropical storm that occurs in the western Pacific Ocean.

words.ex: The earthquake shook the houses last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震震动了房屋。
words.en: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by the passage of seismic waves through Earth's rocks.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: He played badly in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中表现得很差。
words.en: If something is done badly or goes badly, it is not successful or effective.

words.ex: The fish is still alive in the water.
words.ex_cn: 这条鱼还在水里活着。
words.en: If people or animals are alive, they are not dead.

words.tr: n. 水塘；水池；备用物资；美式撞球；
words.ex: The children play near the small pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小水塘边玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that is artificially created.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.tr:
v. 通过；传递；路过；(时间)流逝；
n. 通行证；(考试)及格；
words.ex: He passed the exam with a high score.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: To move or go past someone or something; to transfer or hand over something to someone.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.tr:
adj. 死的；
n. 死人；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The dead bird lay on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 那只死鸟躺在地上。
words.en: No longer alive; deprived of life.

words.ex: My boss gives me work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的老板每天早上给我安排工作。
words.en: A boss is a person who is in charge of other people at work and tells them what to do.

words.ex: He is deaf and uses sign language to communicate.
words.ex_cn: 他是聋的，使用手语交流。
words.en: If someone is deaf, they cannot hear anything, or they cannot hear very well.

words.ex: He stared at the moon all night.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚凝视着月亮。
words.en: To look fixedly or intently at someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.tr:
n. 注意；通知；
v. 注意；留心；通知；
words.ex: He gave a notice about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他发布了关于会议的通知。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.ex: He stayed awake all night to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚醒着完成作业。
words.en: If you are awake, you are not sleeping. If you awake, you wake up.

words.ex: He left the room immediately after the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 铃声一响，他就立即离开了房间。
words.en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

words.tr: adj. 失去的；失踪的； v. 错失；“miss”的现在分词；
words.ex: The missing book was found under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 那本丢失的书在床下找到了。
words.en: If someone or something is missing, they are not in their usual place, and you cannot find them.

words.tr:
n. 同事；（组织的）会员；家伙；同胞；
adj. 同类的；同事的；
words.ex: He works as a fellow with Dr. Smith in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室里与史密斯博士一起工作，是他的同事。
words.en: A fellow is a man or boy. In British English, a fellow is also a member of certain academic societies.

words.tr: phrase. 自然灾害（如地震、洪水、飓风等）
words.ex: The earthquake was a natural disaster.
words.ex_cn: 这场地震是一场自然灾害。
words.en: A natural disaster is a major adverse event resulting from natural processes of the Earth; examples include floods, hurricanes, tornadoes, volcanic eruptions, earthquakes, tsunamis, and other geologic processes.

words.ex: I saw a car pass by my house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一辆车从我家旁边开过。
words.en: To move past or go past something or someone without stopping or without paying attention to them.

words.ex: I will stick with this plan.
words.ex_cn: 我会坚持这个计划。
words.en: To continue to support or use something, even though it may be difficult or you may want to change to something else.

words.tr: phrase. 闲坐着；无所事事地坐着
words.ex: They sit around and talk every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上都坐着聊天。
words.en: If you sit around or sit about, you spend time doing nothing useful or interesting.

words.tr: 短语动词. 没有时间做某事
words.ex: I have no time to do my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我没有时间做作业。
words.en: To be too busy to have the opportunity or time to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 被充耳不闻；被忽视；建议或警告未被理睬
words.ex: His warning fell on deaf ears.
words.ex_cn: 他的警告被当成了耳旁风。
words.en: If something such as a request or piece of advice falls on deaf ears, it is ignored.

words.ex: He stares at the clock every minute.
words.ex_cn: 他每分钟都盯着时钟看。
words.en: To look at someone or something for a long time with the eyes wide open, especially when surprised, angry, or because you are thinking.

words.ex: He looked at me in surprise.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地看着我。
words.en: In a manner that shows you are surprised or startled by something.

words.ex: I will do it for now.
words.ex_cn: 我现在先做它。
words.en: For now is used to indicate that a particular situation exists at the present time and may change in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 生存工具包；应急求生包（通常包含在紧急情况下维持生命所需的物品）
words.ex: He packed a survival kit for his hiking trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的徒步旅行准备了一个救生包。
words.en: A survival kit is a package of basic tools and supplies prepared in advance as an aid to survival in an emergency.

words.ex: The school made an announcement about the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 学校发布了关于假期的通告。
words.en: A public or formal notice about something that has happened or is going to happen.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: The pacific is the largest ocean on Earth.
words.ex_cn: 太平洋是地球上最大的海洋。
words.en: The Pacific Ocean is the body of water between the Americas to the east and Asia and Australia to the west. It is the largest ocean on Earth.

words.ex: He lives in Canada.
words.ex_cn: 他住在加拿大。
words.en: Canada is a country in North America consisting of ten provinces and three territories. Located in the northern part of the continent, it extends from the Atlantic Ocean in the east to the Pacific Ocean in the west and northward into the Arctic Ocean.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: He bought a Canadian maple syrup.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一瓶加拿大的枫糖浆。
words.en: Of or relating to Canada or its people, culture, or language.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.ex_cn: 黑色的反面是白色。
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.ex: He put on his glove before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打棒球前戴上了手套。
words.en: A glove is a piece of clothing which covers your hand and wrist and has individual sections for each finger.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.tr: adj. 温和的；文雅的；温柔的；
words.ex: The mother gave a gentle hug to her child.
words.ex_cn: 母亲给了孩子一个温和的拥抱。
words.en: Someone who is gentle is kind and calm, and does not behave in a violent or harsh way.

words.tr: adj. 诚实的；正直的；坦率的；
words.ex: He gave an honest answer to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向老师给出了一个诚实的回答。
words.en: If you describe someone as honest, you mean that they always tell the truth, and do not try to deceive people or break the law.

words.ex: He tied the box with a strong rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根结实的绳子把箱子绑了起来。
words.en: A rope is a thick cord made by twisting together strands of natural fibers such as hemp or artificial fibers such as nylon.

words.ex: The car moved at a rapid speed.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以迅速的速度行驶。
words.en: A rapid change or event happens very quickly.

words.tr:
prep. 遍于…之上；越过；
adv. 大于；结束；越过；
words.ex: The blanket is over the bed.
words.ex_cn: 毯子盖在床上面。
words.en: In addition to the meanings related to physical position or movement above something, 'over' can also indicate completion, excess, or repetition.

words.ex: He felt shame for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对母亲撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: A painful feeling of humiliation or distress caused by the consciousness of wrong or foolish behavior.

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.ex: He enters the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To come or go into a place; to become involved in a situation or activity; to begin a particular period or stage; to record information in a book or computer.

words.tr: n. 半决赛；半决赛阶段; adj. 半决赛的；参加半决赛的
words.ex: He reached the semifinal of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他进入了网球锦标赛的半决赛。
words.en: A semifinal is one of the two matches or races in a competition that are held to decide who will compete in the final.

words.tr:
adj. 最终的；最后的；
n. 决赛；
words.ex: This is the final answer.
words.ex_cn: 这是最终的答案。
words.en: Last in a series or coming at the end of a process.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 极渴望做某事；非常想（做某事）
words.ex: He is dying to see his favorite band.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望见到他最喜欢的乐队。
words.en: If you say that you are dying for something or dying to do something, you mean that you want to have it or do it very much.

words.tr: phrase. 极想做某事；迫切希望；非常渴望
words.ex_cn: 他急着想看他的新手机。
words.en: If you say that you are dying for something or are dying to do something, you mean that you want to have it or do it very much.

words.tr: phrase. 非常渴望做某事；迫不及待想做某事
words.ex: He is dying to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后急着去踢足球。
words.en: To have a very strong desire or eagerness to do something.

words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.tr: 短语动词。在…处检查；在…处核对；在…处办理登记
words.ex: Please check at the front desk for your package.
words.ex_cn: 请到前台检查你的包裹。
words.en: To examine or inspect something, often for errors or details.

words.tr: 短语，迫不及待地想要做某事
words.ex: I can't wait to see my friend tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我迫不及待想明天见我的朋友。
words.en: to be very excited about something and eager for it to happen

words.tr: 短语. 迫不及待地想做某事
words.ex: I can't wait to see my friend tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我迫不及待想明天见到我的朋友。
words.en: If you say that you can't wait to do something or can hardly wait to do it, you are emphasizing that you are very excited about it and eager to do it.

words.ex: To be honest, I don't like this food.
words.ex_cn: 老实说，我不喜欢这种食物。
words.en: used when you are telling someone what you really think

words.tr: phrasal verb. 跌倒；被绊倒；翻倒
words.ex: The boy falls over and cries.
words.ex_cn: 男孩摔倒了，哭了。
words.en: To fall over means to fall to the ground or to fall down from an upright position.

words.tr: phrase. 保持平衡；保持镇定；稳住身体
words.ex: He tries to keep his balance on the narrow bridge.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在狭窄的桥上保持平衡。
words.en: To maintain one's equilibrium or stability, especially in a challenging or precarious situation.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.tr:
v. 争吵；吵架；
n. 争吵；口角；
words.ex: They quarrel over small things every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天为小事争吵。
words.en: A quarrel is an angry argument or disagreement between people.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.ex: I don't know whether he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他是否会来。
words.en: You use whether when you are talking about a choice or doubt between two or more alternatives.

words.tr:
n. 风险；
v. 冒...的危险；
words.ex: He took a risk by starting his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他创业时承担了风险。
words.en: If there is a risk of something unpleasant, there is a possibility that it will happen.

words.tr:
n. 保卫；警卫；
v. 守卫；
words.ex: The guard stands at the gate to protect the building.
words.ex_cn: 保卫人员站在门口保护大楼。
words.en: A guard is a person who protects a place, person, or thing, or who prevents people from escaping from a place.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: He will cancel the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会取消会议。
words.en: If you cancel something that has been arranged, you stop it from happening. If you cancel an order for goods or services, you tell the person or organization supplying them that you no longer wish to receive them.

words.tr: adj. 明亮的；鲜艳的；聪明的；
words.ex: The room is bright because of the big window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间因为大窗户而很明亮。
words.en: Emitting or reflecting much light; shining.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.ex: The children were silent during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在看电影时很安静。
words.en: Someone or something that is silent makes no noise at all.

words.ex: He plays a musical instrument every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都演奏一件乐器。
words.en: A musical instrument is a device created or adapted to make musical sounds. In principle, any object that produces sound can be considered a musical instrument—it is through purpose that the object becomes a musical instrument.

words.ex: The soldier fought against his enemy in the war.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在战争中与他的敌人作战。
words.en: An enemy is someone who opposes you, competes with you, or is hostile towards you.

words.tr:
adj. 有规律的；经常的；常见的；
n. 常客；
words.ex: He goes for a run every morning, a regular habit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步，这是一个有规律的习惯。
words.en: Something that is regular happens or is done at equal intervals or is consistent in pattern or occurrence.

words.ex: The crowd cheered when the team scored.
words.ex_cn: 当球队得分时，观众欢呼起来。
words.en: If people cheer, they shout loudly to show their approval or to encourage someone who is doing something such as taking part in a game.

words.tr:
adj. 低沉的；低垂的；
adv. 低；低矮；在低处；往下地；
words.ex: He spoke in a low voice to avoid waking the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他用低沉的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If something is low, it is close to the ground, the bottom, or the base of something.

words.ex: His eyesight is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的视力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: He needs time for recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后需要时间恢复。
words.en: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of returning to a normal condition after a period of difficulty.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.tr: phrase. v. 防止；提防；防范
words.ex: Wear a helmet to guard against head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴上头盔以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To guard against something means to take precautions to prevent it from happening.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 抵消；中和；相互抵消
words.ex: The two forces cancel out and the box stays still.
words.ex_cn: 这两个力相互抵消，箱子保持静止。
words.en: If one thing cancels out another thing, the two things have opposite effects, so that when they are combined no real effect is produced.

words.tr: phrase. 往好处想；看光明的一面；保持乐观
words.ex: He lost his job, but he tries to look on the bright side.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，但他努力看到积极的一面。
words.en: To focus on the positive aspects of a situation rather than the negative ones.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.tr: phrase. + prep. 忙于……的；专注于……的
words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正忙于做作业。
words.en: Engaged in or preoccupied with a specific activity or task.

words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正忙于做作业。
words.en: To be actively engaged in a task or activity, often to the exclusion of other activities.

words.tr: phrase. v. 留下；忘带；使落后；丢弃；把…抛在后面
words.ex: He had to leave his old life behind to start a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不告别过去的生活，开始一份新工作。
words.en: To abandon or forget to take someone or something with you when departing.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使高兴起来；振作起来
words.ex: He smiled to cheer up his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着让妹妹振作起来。
words.en: If someone cheers up, or if something cheers them up, they start to feel happier.
